basic_info.description: Come explore this bright and spacious top-floor 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom condo, peacefully located on a quiet street in the heart of Mission Dolores a vibrant, walkable neighborhood that offers the best of city living. This home, available for the first time on the market and still owned by the original owner, features newly renovated maple floors and cabinets, sleek quartz countertops, a modernized kitchen, a freshly updated bathroom, and a generous walk-in closet, seamlessly blending contemporary upgrades with classic charm.  Enjoy access to Valencia Street, the Castro, Dolores Park, Duboce Park, and a variety of top-tier dining and shopping options. With close proximity to public transit, as well as tech shuttles for Google, Meta, Genentech, and more, you'll be ideally situated for an easy commute. This well-maintained elevator building offers excellent amenities, including deeded parking, guest parking, on-site laundry (conveniently located on the same floor), a sauna, an exercise room, and a meeting/rec room.  With a Walk Score of 95, Transit Score of 100, and Bike Score of 99, everything you need is right at your doorstep. Pet-friendly and featuring beautifully common gardens, this home offers a peaceful retreat in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhood!
